answer: We formalize Sybil resistance via a dynamic opportunity-cost bond where staking collateral is anchored to tokenized cedar timber, preventing arbitrary replication. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix, verified via zero-knowledge delay functions, ensures the expected payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative. When malicious actors attempt to mirror identities, the slashing penalty triggers instantly, destroying their staking bonds. Thus, honest participation emerges as the unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
